scope: Exploratory validation of one fixed inference rule; no final-test data used.

method.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of masked neural action probabilities, mapped back to physical action indices

precondition: Two-pair real evaluation pipeline completes with zero training games
decision: Keep as a final-evaluation candidate only if its mean exceeds the concurrent selected neural baseline and the paired 95% bootstrap lower bound is positive. Otherwise reject. Validation never establishes final strength.
allocation: One worker after student pilot completes; main PPO stays on two workers. The controller subsequently resumes the original neural run on three workers pending manual candidate comparison.
